leg2b.question: can the signature still be checked tomorrow?
leg2b.finding: quilt-chrono mints a RUNTIME-ONLY Ed25519 identity: the private key never leaves the process and re-runs mint a fresh one. The committed receipt therefore CANNOT be re-verified by anyone. A signature by a key you no longer hold is not a signature you can check, and the three-leg vocabulary has no word for it. The best key hygiene and the best receipts are in TENSION: a runtime-only key cannot be stolen, and a seal made with it can never be re-checked.
